evidence: emerging regulations and laws governing the use of artificial intelligence may adversely impact our use of these technologies

The dissemination of proprietary Company or negative information, whether or not accurate, by customers, employees, social media influencers, artificial intelligence, and others via social media could harm our business
Advances in technologies such as artificial intelligence or alternative methods of delivery could have a negative effect on our business and market position

failure to incorporate artificial intelligence technologies into our business as successfully as our competitors could adversely impact us, as could any deficiencies, unreliability or other failures of artificial intelligence systems
The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies may also heighten our cybersecurity risks by making cyber-attacks more difficult to detect, contain, and mitigate
ai_positioning.summary: Papa John's adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques réglementaires, concurrentiels et cybersécuritaires plutôt que sur les opportunités d'innovation. L'entreprise reconnaît l'importance d'intégrer l'IA mais craint de ne pas suivre le rythme de ses concurrents.
